items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: INTERVIEWER: What's your mother's name? Mary.

ctx.x: Did you come from a large family? You had a brother and a sister? I'm the only child. What's your mother's name? Mary. Your father's name? James. So you would do a name after the father. Did he play music?
No. Well, my father sung in the choir at church. And I did too for a while. Well, in fact I still do. But he never played music for a living.
